text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Flash-san,
your cold is totally gone now, huh~☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for all your help back then.
—A few nights ago.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, I've taken full precautions,
so there is no need to worry so much... *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! You clearly have a fever
and look so unwell! Please let me nurse you back to health.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm, for a cold, maybe hot ginger tea?
Ah, but I wonder if it's different in Germany?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In Germany, herbal tea is typically the mainstream remedy, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Herb tea, got it!
Ah, let me guess, you have a secret family recipe, don't you?
All right, Falco's gonna make it using that♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Was the recipe notebook around here~? I feel like the dried herbs were put away here too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah... You shouldn't just make a mess like that...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Tja... Good grief...
I'll write down the recipe,
so please give me just two minutes."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! First, warm up the teapot~,
and blend the herbs in the meantime☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's so detailed!
And you're mixing nine different types~~?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, quietly... Eep! Too much, too much!
The water temperature should be... around this much, right?
The steeping time is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: H-How does it taste~? I hope it turned out delicious~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...There is a bit too much lemongrass.
And also... it seems the steeping time
was about 15 seconds too long."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you understand~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“But, well... even if it tastes a little off,
it'll still give you energy, right?
It's packed full of loooove, after all! ☆”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I wouldn't say the flavor is anywhere near perfect...
However... love, is it...?)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as you said,
it proved to be more than effective."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right? An Umadol's love power
is truly incredible, after all~☆
